neighbours.label: the opening of a quoted utterance that starts with an interjection or greeting ('"Oh.', 'The greeting "Merry Christmas"'); scare quotes and quoted titles stay quiet
fire: "Oh. I didn't expect you so early," he said, opening the door.
The usual greeting "Good morning" sounds strange at midnight.
"Oh! You found my keys," she laughed.
Everyone shouted the greeting "Happy birthday" as she walked in.
"Oh, wow. That is a big dog," the child whispered.
Nobody answered his cheerful greeting "Hello there" from the porch.
"Oh no. The train has already left," Maria sighed.
In the morning the greeting "Season's greetings" was painted on the shop window.
